images.title: The order for a first VA hire
images.alt: Five stages of hiring a first virtual assistant: pick a task, document it, post a specific job, run a paid trial, onboard with limited access.
images.caption: Most of the effort sits in the first two stages, before you talk to anyone.

items.label: Document it
items.text: A screen recording plus a short written checklist

items.label: Post a specific job
items.text: Name the task, the hours and the tools

items.label: Run a paid trial
items.text: The same small task for two or three people

items.label: Onboard the best one
items.text: With limited access to your accounts

images.title: How to run a paid trial task
images.alt: Steps for a VA trial: shortlist two or three people, give the same one to two hour task, pay everyone, then review how they worked.
images.caption: A small mistake with clear communication usually beats getting it right in silence.

items.title: Shortlist two or three people
items.text: Choose them from the people who answered your post.

items.title: Give everyone the same task
items.text: Take it from the real work and build it on your documentation. One to two hours is plenty.

items.title: Pay for every trial
items.text: Pay the agreed rate whether or not you hire them.

items.title: Review more than the result
items.text: Did they follow the document, ask when unclear and deliver when they said they would?

images.after: Give access without handing over your accounts
images.title: Give access, not your identity
images.alt: Checklist for sharing account access with a VA: no main email password, separate users, password manager sharing, no money access, a shared list.
images.caption: Turn on two-factor authentication for your own accounts before you add anyone.

items: Never share your main email password; use delegation instead
Create a separate user with a limited role wherever the tool allows
Share other logins through a password manager
Keep banking, payments and ad billing out of scope at first
Keep a list of everything you've shared
